explain_task.question: Using the revised model’s `FarmBiosecurity.lp_relaxation.json`, identify which constraints are binding and interpret their shadow prices in business terms by tracing `_C3` and `_C4` back to the exact code lines and the exact `general_parameters.csv` / `table_1.csv` field names they use. Then explain why opening poultry is unattractive at the margin by connecting the reduced cost of `coop_open` to the business brief’s “gate” language and to the exact code variables/parameters `coop_open`, `large_flock_review`, `biosecurity_training_aw_days`, `biosecurity_training_ss_days`, `fixed_cost_chicken_setup`, and `min_chickens_if_coop_open`. Finally, compare original vs revised and pinpoint the exact added binary-variable logic that changes the model class but not the optimum here, and explain why a linear extrapolation from the LP shadow prices would fail if management asked for the value of allowing a tiny positive amount of chickens.
